pages.text: Small friends to tame by feeding:$(li)Red panda: bamboo$(li)Ferret: raw chicken$(li)Shima enaga: seeds$(li)Snail: carrots$(li)Ladybug: mushrooms$(li)Jumping spider: dragonfly wings (heal it with spider eyes or rotten flesh)
